projectContext: Improve YouTube download resilience through retry mechanisms, progressive backoff, and configurable rate-limit handling. Key gap: config.yaml has max_retries/retry_delay/retry_backoff settings that are NOT used in VideoDownloader._run_download_cmd(). Cookie rotator and VPN manager exist but escalation is too aggressive.

userStories.title: Implement exponential backoff retry in _run_download_cmd
userStories.description: The download config defines max_retries (3), retry_delay (2s), and retry_backoff (2.0) but these are NOT used in VideoDownloader._run_download_cmd(). Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures.
acceptanceCriteria: VideoDownloader._run_download_cmd uses config.download.max_retries for retry attempts
Delay between retries follows exponential backoff: retry_delay * (retry_backoff ^ attempt)
Retries only occur for transient errors (timeout, connection reset, 429 rate limit)
Permanent errors (video unavailable, private, age-restricted) fail immediately without retry
Each retry attempt is logged with attempt number and delay duration
Unit tests verify retry behavior with mocked subprocess calls
userStories.notes: Implemented retry loop in _run_download_cmd with TRANSIENT_ERROR_PATTERNS and PERMANENT_ERROR_PATTERNS class variables. 21 new unit tests in tests/test_downloader_retry.py. All 68 related tests pass.

userStories.title: Add progressive backoff before cookie rotation
userStories.description: Currently rate limit errors immediately trigger cookie rotation. Add a progressive delay phase before escalating to cookie rotation to handle brief rate-limit windows.
acceptanceCriteria: New config option download.rate_limit.initial_backoff_seconds (default: 5)
New config option download.rate_limit.max_backoff_before_rotate (default: 60)
Rate limit errors trigger exponential backoff BEFORE rotating cookies
After max_backoff_before_rotate seconds total delay, then rotate cookie
Backoff progress is logged for debugging
Tests verify backoff occurs before rotation
userStories.notes: Added RateLimitConfig dataclass with initial_backoff_seconds (5.0), max_backoff_before_rotate (60.0), backoff_multiplier (2.0). Modified handle_rate_limit_error() to apply progressive backoff before rotation. Added _reset_rate_limit_backoff() for state reset on success. 20 new unit tests in tests/test_rate_limit_backoff.py. All 57 download/cookie/retry tests pass.

userStories.title: Make cookie rotator error patterns configurable
userStories.description: Cookie rotator has hard-coded error patterns (429, rate limit, etc.) at line 222. Move patterns to config.yaml so users can add new YouTube error formats without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: New config section download.cookie_rotation.error_patterns as list of strings
Default patterns include: 429, rate limit, too many requests, sign in, login required, bot detection
CookieRotator.rotate_on_errors() reads from config instead of hard-coded list
Patterns support case-insensitive matching
Config validation ensures error_patterns is a non-empty list
Tests verify custom patterns trigger rotation
userStories.notes: Error patterns already configurable via rotate_on_errors in CookieRotationConfig. Added __post_init__ validation for non-empty list when enabled. Case-insensitive matching via .lower(). Also added cookie file validation at startup (validates existence AND readability, logs warnings with reason, get_status includes valid_cookies count). 28 tests pass in test_cookie_rotation.py (8 validation + 5 custom patterns + 15 existing).

userStories.title: Add search timeout fallback with keyword remix
userStories.description: Search queries that timeout (yt-dlp search hangs) currently kill the entire keyword. Add fallback to try remixed keyword when search times out.
acceptanceCriteria: Search timeout (default: 30s) is detected separately from download timeout
On search timeout, try LLM keyword remix before giving up
New config option download.search_timeout_seconds (default: 30)
Maximum 2 remix attempts per original keyword on timeout
Timeout is logged with original keyword and remix attempts
Tests verify remix is tried after search timeout
userStories.notes: Implemented SearchResult class in title_filter.py to track timeout state. Modified search_video_metadata() to return SearchResult with timed_out flag. Updated _download_single() in core.py with timeout-based remix loop (max 2 attempts). Changed search_timeout default from 60s to 30s. 18 new tests in tests/test_search_timeout_remix.py. Updated existing test mocks to use SearchResult. All 23 related tests pass.

userStories.title: Implement download speed monitoring for adaptive timeouts
userStories.description: Current tier-based timeouts are fixed. Track actual download speeds per session to dynamically adjust timeouts based on network conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: New DownloadSpeedTracker class tracks bytes downloaded and time per video
Average speed calculated across last 5 downloads (sliding window)
Timeout can be extended by up to 2x if speed is below expected threshold
Speed stats exposed via get_speed_stats() for debugging
Tracker state persisted in checkpoint for resume scenarios
Tests verify timeout extension on slow networks
userStories.notes: Implemented DownloadSpeedTracker class in src/downloader/speed_tracker.py with DownloadSpeedConfig dataclass (enabled, window_size=5, min_speed_mbps=1.0, max_timeout_multiplier=2.0). DownloadRecord tracks per-video stats with speed_mbps property. Sliding window via deque(maxlen=window_size). get_adjusted_timeout() extends timeout proportionally when speed < min_speed_mbps. Added SpeedTrackingConfig to download.py config, integrated in core.py _run_download_cmd(). Checkpoint persistence via speed_tracker_state field in DownloadCheckpoint. 28 tests in test_speed_tracker.py covering config, recording, averaging, adaptive timeout, checkpoint persistence, and integration. All 356 download tests pass.

userStories.title: Add circuit breaker for repeated search failures
userStories.description: If multiple keywords in a row fail to return results, pause searching briefly instead of hammering YouTube. Implement circuit breaker pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: New config option download.circuit_breaker.consecutive_failures_threshold (default: 5)
New config option download.circuit_breaker.pause_seconds (default: 60)
After threshold consecutive search failures, pause for pause_seconds
Circuit breaker resets on first successful search
Pause duration is logged clearly (not hidden in debug)
Tests verify circuit breaker triggers and resets correctly

userStories.title: Add batch-level retry queue for rate-limited videos
userStories.description: Currently each video retries independently. If rate limiting affects a batch, collect failed videos and retry the entire batch after a delay.
acceptanceCriteria: New RetryQueue class collects rate-limited video IDs with their keywords
After batch completes, retry queue is processed with backoff
New config option download.batch_retry.enabled (default: true)
New config option download.batch_retry.delay_seconds (default: 120)
Maximum 2 batch retry passes per download session
Tests verify batch retry with multiple failed videos

userStories.title: Add rate limit cooldown tracking across sessions
userStories.description: Rate limit history is lost between pipeline runs. Persist rate limit events to avoid aggressive retries when resuming after rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit events saved to checkpoint with timestamp
On resume, check if last rate limit was within cooldown period
New config option download.rate_limit.resume_cooldown_minutes (default: 15)
If within cooldown, start with longer delays and skip to VPN/cookie rotation faster
Cooldown status logged on pipeline resume
Tests verify cooldown applied on resume

userStories.title: Add download healer integration with retry mechanism
userStories.description: DownloadHealer in src/agents/healers/download.py has backoff logic but it's not integrated with the new retry mechanism. Ensure healers and retry work together.
acceptanceCriteria: DownloadHealer checks if _run_download_cmd already retried before applying its own backoff
New flag passed to healer: already_retried_count
Healer skips exponential backoff if retries already exhausted
Healer proceeds directly to cookie/VPN rotation after retries exhausted
Clear logging shows retry handoff between core and healer
Tests verify healer skips redundant retries

userStories.title: Add rate limiting metrics to pipeline report
userStories.description: After pipeline completes, show rate limiting statistics so users can tune their config. Add metrics to the healing report.
acceptanceCriteria: New RateLimitMetrics class tracks: retries, backoffs, cookie rotations, VPN switches
Metrics include: total_downloads, rate_limit_events, avg_retry_count, time_spent_backing_off
Metrics printed in healing report under 'Rate Limiting' section
Metrics saved to checkpoint for cross-session analysis
Config recommendations printed if rate_limit_events > 10% of downloads
Tests verify metrics collection and report output
